```artifact
Feature: Bank Account Transactions

  Scenario: Deposit increases balance by the deposited amount
    Given the account has a balance of 1000
    When the user deposits 200
    Then the account balance should be 1200

  Scenario Outline: Deposit amount limits
    Given the account has a balance of 1000
    When the user attempts to deposit <amount>
    Then <outcome>

    Examples:
      | amount | outcome                                 |
      | 0       | an InvalidAmount error is returned      |
      | 1       | the account balance should be 1001      |
      | 100     | the account balance should be 1100      |
      | 50000   | the account balance should be 51000     |
      | 50001   | an InvalidAmount error is returned      |

  Scenario: Withdrawal decreases balance by the withdrawn amount
    Given the account has a balance of 1000
    When the user withdraws 300
    Then the account balance should be 700

  Scenario: Withdrawal greater than 10,000 is rejected
    Given the account has a balance of 20000
    When the user attempts to withdraw 10001
    Then a LimitExceeded error is returned

  Scenario: Withdrawal that would make balance negative is rejected
    Given the account has a balance of 1000
    When the user attempts to withdraw 1500
    Then an InsufficientFunds error is returned
```
